result.title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
result.summary: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 Spatial Foundry 数据集，包含 5,280 个可编辑家具住宅 3D 场景，并对其提供对齐的平面图、透视图与全景 RGB、深度、点云、网格、实例级 3D 框及相机轨迹视频，用统一场景坐标链接跨视角与跨时间观测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该数据共享场景坐标并提供可控相机与物体变化，可能可供核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留跨视角几何与持久场景状态、以及视觉证据筛选与停止决策的评价设计，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理或 VLM 训练。
